Title: Y.A.R.V.I.S. // Holographic System Interface
Desc: Y.A.R.V.I.S. - A holographic desktop HUD with live hardware telemetry, Windows media metadata, audio-reactive reactor graphics, a reactive alert state machine, a cycling module deck, an event-driven Y.A.R.V.I.S. commentary log, and a four-level effect intensity control.
Author: raystanza
